reason: E1 and E2 support that entropy stabilizes phases at high temperature and that rapid cooling can freeze a high-entropy state, but they do not demonstrate that varying cooling rate or composition controls crystal-structure selection, nor do they specifically address noble metal–based systems; E3 is about oxide perovskites and irrelevant.
